description: Convert swim distance and time into pace per 100m, pace per 100 yards, and swimming speed.

faqs.a: Most pools are 25m or 50m. Enter the total distance you swam in meters — e.g. 1500 for 60 lengths of a 25m pool.
faqs.q: How do I enter pool distance?

faqs.a: Divide your total time by the number of 100m segments you swam. This tool does it automatically.
100 yards equals 91.44 meters, so a 100-yard pace is slightly faster (shorter time) than a 100m pace.
faqs.q: Why are the 100m and 100yd paces different?

howto: Enter the total distance you swam in meters.
Enter your total swim time in minutes and seconds.
Compare your pace per 100m and per 100 yards.
title: Swimming Pace Calculator
